messages:
kai: hey folks, day 2 and I'm trying to set up meeting notes + a runbook in Notion. I can open the Templates library but Duplicate is disabled
nora: welcome! Templates live in Company Home > DevEx > Templates Library. most templates are view-only so we don't accidentally change the canonical ones
kai: got it. I clicked Request edit access but nothing happened (no email). what's the usual flow?
sam: sometimes Okta sync lags. request should create an Okta ticket and devex-bot auto-adds you to 'Redwood - Docs Editors'. if that doesn't happen in ~5m ping this thread and we'll add you manually
kai: thanks. also curious: if I duplicate the meeting notes, where should I put it so others can find it? team page or personal workspace?
nora: put it under Company Home > Teams > <Your Team> so it shows up in the team index. then use 'Add to Docs Index' on the page and fill Owner, Tags, Short summary
sam: quick naming pattern we use: "<Team> - Short title". runbooks: prefix with "RB -" is optional but helpful. examples: "RB - cache clear (kc-wallet)" or "Platform - release notes"
kai: I got no email again. can someone add me?
devex-bot: devex-bot received request to add kai to 'Redwood - Docs Editors' (okta)
sam: adding now
devex-bot: devex-bot added kai to "Redwood - Docs Editors" (okta)
kai: I can duplicate now :tada: one last question when I create a new runbook from the template, what's the minimum fields to fill so it passes the index checks?
nora: minimum: Title, Owner, Short summary (1 line), Tags (at least one), Parent team (select), and 'Add to Docs Index' entry. we also ask you to add a short steps section and a contact point for escalation
sam: copyable checklist we ask folks to run through before making pages public:
```
- Title: Team - Short title
- Owner: @your-name
- Visibility: Team or Company
- Tags: #runbook #infra #product
- Summary: 1-line description
- Index: Add to Docs Index DB and set Parent team
- Contacts: escalation contact + oncall
- Review: optional devex review request
```
kai: perfect, added the runbook draft and indexed it. pinging for a quick review: https://notion.fake/redwood/abc123
nora: looking now, will comment in-line. also FYI we try to keep templates unchanged; if you find improvements suggest them in the Templates Feedback thread and devex will update the canonical template
kai: thanks y'all for the quick help :)
